data.name: Operator Training：Heavy Equipment
data.detailed_description:
Operator Training：Heavy Equipment – Realistic Construction Simulator

Welcome to Operator Training：Heavy Equipment — a highly realistic professional equipment driving simulator built for hardcore simulation players and heavy machinery enthusiasts. Centered around precision operation simulation + open environments, the game recreates real machinery operation and construction workflows at a 1:1 scale. With full instructional guidance, professional evaluation, and a dynamic weather system, it delivers an immersive engineering experience like never before.

Powered by an advanced physics engine, the game accurately simulates equipment movement and control feedback. A dynamic weather system recreates real working conditions—including sunshine, rain, fog, and snow—putting your operating skills to the test under varying environments. The initial release features three classic construction machines: Excavator, Rotary Drilling Rig, and Tower Crane, with more equipment planned in future updates.

Each machine comes with three difficulty modes: Practice, Mission, and Professional. Start with the fundamentals, progress to more complex tasks, and ultimately take on a full evaluation in Professional mode within realistic scenarios. Whether you're a simulation game fan or a curious newcomer, you’ll find your own rhythm and a clear path for skill growth here.

Equipment Highlights

🔧 Excavator

Experience the true operation of a crawler excavator! From startup checks and smooth maneuvering to basic movements and earthmoving tasks, every step replicates actual construction processes. The game offers multi-view switching (first-person, god view, third-person) and real-time instrument parameter displays (RPM, water temperature, work mode, etc.), allowing you to master standard operating techniques in a virtual environment and feel the power and precision of heavy machinery.

🔧 Rotary Drilling Rig

Take on the challenge of high-precision pile foundation construction! The entire process – from loading onto transport vehicles and equipment assembly, to basic drilling, gravel layer drilling, and rock layer drilling – is realistically simulated. You will master professional operations such as basic equipment control, drill pipe hoisting, and disassembly, completing drilling tasks under various geological conditions, and experience the critical role of rotary drilling rigs in infrastructure projects.

🔧 Tower Crane

Step into the role of a high-altitude “commander” and complete precision lifting tasks. The game recreates an authentic tower crane operating interface and a multi-angle hook camera system (cab view, hook front/rear views, and external view), while displaying key parameters in real time—including wind speed, lifting load, and rotation angle. Work with voice and signal guidance to carry out complex lifting operations and experience the pressure and professionalism of working at height.

Key Features

✅ 1:1 realistic equipment models and operation workflows

✅ Dynamic weather system with real-world environmental challenges

✅ Three difficulty modes for step-by-step skill progression

✅ Multi-view switching + real-time instrument feedback

✅Provides Chinese and English language support

✅ Ongoing updates — more machines will be added over time

About the Team

This game is developed by DataMesh, leveraging years of experience in industrial simulation and training system development. Our goal is to transform professional training content into a simulation game experience with both entertainment and educational value.

🏢 Enterprise/Institution Customization Support

We also provide custom motion platform solutions, including 6-DOF, 3-DOF, and simplified simulator cabin hardware options, designed for professional training scenarios such as enterprise programs and vocational education.

For customization inquiries, please use the “Enterprise Entry” link on this Steam store page.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system, Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700或AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3050Ti 4G
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system, Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600H或AMD Ryzen 9 5900HS
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070Ti 8G
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
